meta.title: happy birthday kb-fr08 remix
meta.author: V2mPlayer
meta.description: happy birthday kb-fr08 remix by V2mPlayer, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from the V2M collection of jgilje/v2m-player (`v2m/V2mPlayer--happy_birthday_kb-fr08_remix.v2mz`; its README points to modland). 120 BPM, 4:46, 15 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
